newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil product firm, gasoline barges by $13.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil product firm, gasoline barges by $13.

text.p: Prompt gasoline barges soared again on Monday, by in excess of $10 a tonne, while other products ticked up by about $1, dealers said.
Eurograde gasoline barges traded from $222 to $227 fob ARA, the latter some $13 above Friday's late trading level.
"It's not trading hype. There's a genuine shortage of gasoline in Europe," one trader said.
"It's going up every half hour," said another.
Swaps were hard to assess, but August was valued at roughly $216 fob ARA with the August/September backwardation widening to $14/$17 a tonne.

One of the three catalytic crackers which went down late last week, at Nerefco's Europoort refinery in Rotterdam, returned to operation on Monday morning, but did little to improve the supply situation in the area. Some traders said it was not yet running at full capacity.
Heating oil barges were about $1 a tonne higher as IPE August gas oil futures strengthened. The market remained quiet with offers at IPE August +$1 fob Rotterdam.
High sulphur fuel oil barges were also up $1 a tonne, trading at $94 and $94.25 fob Rotterdam to one ARA major. Late morning offers were at $95.
